# AstryxThumbnail { #anylumino.AstryxThumbnail }

```python
AstryxThumbnail(label='', src='', alt='', **props)
```

Render an Astryx thumbnail image or placeholder.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Default   |
|---------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| label   | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `''`      |
| src     | str    | Image or media source URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `''`      |
| alt     | str    | Accessible alternative text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | `''`      |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Thumbnail props. Useful keys: isLoading, isDisabled, data-testid, className, and style. Upstream onRemove and onClick expect JavaScript functions and are not adapted by the Python bridge. anylumino manages label, src, and alt. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Thumbnail>. | `{}`      |
